title: Lab size, from everyone alone to one lab of everyone, on a graph where deeper ideas are harder by 1 bit per level
html:
Lab size, from everyone alone to one lab of everyone, on a graph where deeper ideas are harder by 1 bit per level

Question: On a graph where deeper ideas are harder by 1 bit per level, with 24 agents in labs of 1 to 24 that share inside the lab, how much money does the field need, against OSO across the whole field?

Answer: At budgets 8–16: best Traditional (α = 1, β = 0), alone (7 measures). At budget 32: best OSO (α = 0.8, β = 1). Against traditional, clearly better on hardest level, knowledge found (bits) and knowledge per unit of money; no clear difference on targets solved, bounty value, ROI and waste. At budget 64: best OSO (α = 0.2, β = 1). Against traditional, clearly better on hardest level, knowledge found (bits), knowledge per unit of money and waste; no clear difference on targets solved, bounty value and ROI.
